review.method: Each upstream it() body was read from the pinned chat-client.test.ts and compared line by line with the Dart test body: connection mode, push ordering, clear timing, persistence callbacks, callback lists, and exact expected values. Names were used only to pair candidates.
review.nativeMode: Cases that upstream drives through subscribe/send use a real ConnectionAdapter(subscribe + send) with a pushable broadcast stream. Gated / non-cooperative cases use ConnectionAdapter(connect), as upstream does.
review.persistence: Upstream ChatPersistence keys are adaptation-only in Dart: the adapter is constructed with the thread id and getItem/setItem/removeItem take no key. Assertions compare transcript rows instead of object identity.
review.failingPolicy: All 37 ported cases pass in the final verified run. Earlier failures were implementation gaps and were kept as failing evidence until Codex closed them; no case was deleted, skipped, or weakened.
